title: I'm making a bullet-hell where you only get one shot… and you have to recall it
author: summercomet_
selftext:
Made with Opus 5.5 and Three.js

Inkscape was used for the graphics.

It plays like a regular shoot'em up, but your shot act more like a golf ball... and you need to bring it back after each shot.

There are power-ups to add variety to the gameplay, like a large explosion when bouncing of screen border, one that makes your tether a laser that deals damage, and an explosion when interrupting recall.

The visuals and UI still need to be reworked a bit, but the core gameplay is here (I'm planning to make 2 levels)

comments.author: jakethunderpants
comments.body:
Turn it into a yo-yo.

Progression unlocks new ways of using the yo-yo (look at what the world championship yo-yo tournaments do). 

Different yo-yos can behave differently, basically different types of weapons. Or maybe some are stronger than others. 

Become a dual-wielding yo-yo master in the end game. 

I’m pretty sure the yo-yo was a weapon with Filipino culture. 

Either way, very cool mechanic. This is just where my head went when I saw it, haha. Keep working on it!

replies.author: summercomet_
replies.body:
Glad you like it!  
I like the ideas of having different weapons (some could be longer to load, but traveling faster. Or perhaps they could act like a guided missile). I’ll see what I can do.  
I’ll also try to have a short demo ready to share by the end of the week.
